devicedata.name: SwitchBot Curtain
devicedata.creator: Custom driver (unofficial)
devicedata.copyright: Custom driver, not affiliated with SwitchBot
devicedata.description: Controls one SwitchBot curtain or blind through the SwitchBot cloud API v1.1. Untested against live hardware; see README.

property.name: Token
property.description: SwitchBot API token (from the SwitchBot app, Developer Options). Stored by Composer; never logged.

property.name: Secret
property.description: SwitchBot API secret key (from the SwitchBot app, Developer Options). Never logged.

property.name: Device ID
property.description: Device ID of this curtain. Copy it from Discovered Devices after running Discover Devices.

property.name: Discovered Devices
property.description: Curtain and blind devices on the account: name | id | type.

property.name: Status
property.description: Last driver status (Online, Auth failed, Rate limited, and so on).

property.name: Battery
property.description: Battery percentage reported by the device.

property.name: Low Battery Threshold
property.description: Fires the Low Battery event when the battery is below this percentage.

property.name: Invert Level
property.description: True: Control4 100 = open, mapped to SwitchBot position 100 - level (API 0 = open). False: no mapping.

command.name: Set Position
command.description: Move to a Control4 level from 0 to 100 (100 = open when Invert Level is True).

event.name: Low Battery
event.description: Battery is below the Low Battery Threshold.
